performance.verdict: Retargeting pool exhausted; 5 overdue SOW milestones now threaten renewal decision.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue (earliest 2026-07-23): phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and August scoreboard all undelivered — renewal decision is now at risk.
CPL spiked 79.29% in 7 days; last 3 days (Sep 5–7) averaged only 2.7 leads/day vs 4.3 in prior 3 days (Sep 2–4), confirming the efficiency collapse is worsening, not stabilising.

Retargeting campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' consumed $424.38 of $823.34 (52%) over 28 days with flat prospecting spend — audience pool depletion is the most likely cause of the lead drop.
GBP actions fell 100% in the last 7 days; series shows zero actions from Aug 31 onward (8 straight days), cutting an organic lead source that averaged 8.4 actions/day prior.
GHL shows 112 opportunities created vs 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — leads are arriving but not converting to booked visits, signalling an intake/pipeline leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Shift ~$10/day (~40%) from retargeting to a prospecting campaign to replenish the depleted audience pool.
suggestions.monday_update: Retargeting ('BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting') has consumed 52% of 28-day spend ($424.38 of $823.34) while leads fell 47% and CPL rose 79% in 7 days. Reduce retargeting daily budget by ~$10/day and reallocate to an active or new prospecting campaign to replenish the top-of-funnel audience. Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $7.55 and daily leads average ≥4/day within 7 days. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP listing — 8 consecutive zero-action days since Aug 31 is not seasonal noise.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero from Aug 31 onward (8 days at 0 vs prior average of ~8.4 actions/day). Check listing suspension status, recent edits, and photo/post health immediately. Success check: GBP actions resume at ≥5/day within 5 business days. Flag to Nacer and Sohib if listing is suspended, as this directly impacts the August scoreboard.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake path: 112 opps created, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm leads are being worked, not stalling.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 112 opportunities created with 0 appointments and 0 won in 28 days — the pipeline is filling but nothing is converting. Audit the intake workflow with Lily and the new hire to confirm follow-up sequences are firing and leads are being contacted within 24 hours. This is distinct from an ads problem. Success check: at least 10 appointments booked in GHL within 14 days. This directly blocks the renewal scoreboard metric of leads → scheduled → showed.
